note: Every entry is dated and attributed. Where official material and press coverage disagree, both are recorded with their dates rather than silently resolved. The affects array lists the wiki pages this item changed, so a reader can see the news feed and the guide agree.

entries.title: Pre-order editions and prices, with a caveat on what 'exclusive' means
entries.summary: Checked against the official product page and Steam listings. The small print on the official page says bonus content can also be obtained through in-game progression, but it sits under both edition blocks while the two Deluxe outfits are separately labelled Exclusive. Those two statements cannot both be fully true, so this page records the conflict instead of picking a side.
facts: Standard Edition on Steam (US) is $59.99; Digital Deluxe is $69.99
Pre-order bonus in both editions: the Treasure Basin accessory and the Legacy appearance
Treasure Basin is described as raising Remnant Dust drop rate by 10%
Deluxe adds the Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form appearances, a digital artbook and the digital soundtrack
The official page states that bonus content can also be obtained through in-game progression - but the two Deluxe appearances are labelled Exclusive, so whether they are earnable is unresolved
No early access: the Deluxe Edition does not let anyone play before the release date
Buying the Deluxe Edition on pre-order also includes the pre-order bonuses, per the PlayStation.com footnote
entries.source: Official Phantom Blade Zero site, plus Steam and PlayStation Store listings checked 2026-10-16

entries.title: Director on weapon balance: the team deliberately did not make everything equal
entries.summary: PC Games N visited S-Game in Beijing and asked director Soulframe Liang how 30 weapons get balanced. The answer was that they are not, and that this is intentional.
facts: The director said the team was happy they did not have to make everything 100% balanced
Bosses can be chipped at with anything in the arsenal, but specific weapons blunt specific attacks - the example given was a fight where one weapon reduced the impact of the boss's main attack
The game does not push players toward particular equipment; it leaves the counter-weapon discovery to the player
Unlock order is deliberate, and more undisclosed weapons are still to be revealed
The advice given is to try every weapon when you find it
entries.source: PC Games N, interview with Soulframe Liang

entries.title: IGN shows The Hunt boss fight and the first look at Blood-Steel Form
entries.summary: IGN released gameplay of a boss called The Hunt - the assassin Soul fights on the moving cart in the opening - together with a first look at Blood-Steel Form, one of the two Deluxe Edition outfits.
facts: The Hunt is the opening-act assassin, fought atop a moving cart, and is considerably tougher than that first encounter suggests
Coverage describes the fight as parrying across four axes
Blood-Steel Form is a Deluxe Edition exclusive appearance, shown for the first time in this clip
What weapon, if any, The Hunt drops has not been announced
Steam's own copy says weapons are wrested from fallen foes, so a drop is a reasonable inference but is not confirmed
entries.source: IGN video, written up by GamingBolt and GamerFuzion

entries.title: No physical edition at launch, and the unlock time is now known
entries.summary: Two logistics facts settled over this week. Play-Asia removed its boxed PS5 listing after being told none is coming, and the PlayStation Store listing puts the global unlock at 02:00 UTC on 29 October.
facts: No physical PlayStation 5 edition at launch; a retailer listing was withdrawn. A later boxed release is speculation, not an announcement
Global unlock is 02:00 UTC on October 29, which is 7 PM Pacific and 10 PM Eastern on October 28
PC launches at the same time as PS5, and PC is via Steam and the Epic Games Store
As of this date, no review embargo, preload window or install size had been announced
entries.source: NoobFeed on the physical edition; GamerFuzion citing the PlayStation Store listing

entries.title: Preview wave: 50+ bosses, 30-40 hours, stealth takedowns - and frame-rate concern
entries.summary: A second round of previews landed from writers who had hands-on time at gamescom 2026 and at the Los Angeles event. Together they put numbers on scope, and one raised the first real technical worry.
facts: The director stated the game has at least 50 bosses, with the boss count roughly matching the weapon count since bosses are where weapons come from

He described the arsenal as 30 main weapons and around 20 secondary weapons. Note this differs slightly from the August PlayStation Blog post, which said more than 30 main and 25 Phantom Edges; both are recorded with their dates
Expected playthrough length given as 30 to 40 hours, varying with difficulty and how much you explore
GamerBraves, after three hours at gamescom 2026, described rooftop and terrain assassinations, so exploration feeds combat rather than sitting beside it
GameScreed reported rare but extreme frame-rate drops even on a high-end PC in the preview build, and noted the preview was PC-only, so console performance is still unknown
The same piece flagged that the combat's deeper weapon-switching systems take time to internalise

entries.title: Final hands-on previews: boss phase retry, Nioh-style chapters, Denuvo and path tracing on PC
entries.summary: S-Game lifted the embargo on its last pre-release preview round, held in Los Angeles. Coverage from three outlets plus a group Q&A with director Soulframe Liang and publishing head Will Chen added structural detail that was not in any earlier official material.
facts: Chapters are self-contained levels with alternative paths and optional bosses, compared by hands-on writers to Nioh 1 and 2 rather than to an open world
If you reach a boss's second phase and die shortly after, you can re-challenge from the unlocked phase with a refreshed arsenal instead of replaying the whole first section
The opening gives a choice between two hearts; the 66-day heart is not selectable on a first run and is a tease for what unlocks later
66 Days mode is not required for the PlayStation 5 platinum trophy, per the developers at the Q&A
Side quests are deliberately few and heavy: the director said the cast does not get errand quests because the protagonist has 66 days to live
QTEs are short and fragmentary, inserted between combos rather than replacing play; the opening wagon fight is real combat under a fixed camera
Boss fights each have their own dynamic soundtrack, and a second phase changes musical genre while reusing the fight's leitmotif
PC ships with Denuvo anti-tamper and supports path tracing; official PC system requirements were published

entries.title: Difficulty corrected to four modes, and the standard tier is named Pathbreaker
entries.summary: The August State of Play showed four difficulty options on the menu. PlayStation's own English blog post named only three of them, which is why some guides still say three; contemporaneous coverage of the same broadcast, the game's Wikipedia article and later hands-on write-ups all name the fourth, Pathbreaker, as the standard tier.
facts: Four modes: Wayfarer, Pathbreaker, Hellwalker and 66 Days
Wayfarer is described by S-Game as intuitive and cinematic, for players who want the story
Pathbreaker is the standard difficulty and the closest match to the balance the combat was built around
Hellwalker adds fighting-game mechanics and bosses that do not rely on preset attack patterns, adapting to the player
66 Days runs at Hellwalker intensity and adds a counter starting at 66 that drops by one per death; reaching zero ends the run
66 Days unlocks after completing Pathbreaker or Hellwalker; finishing on Wayfarer does not unlock it
Earlier previews called the standard tier Gamechanger. Two independent write-ups state the name changed to Pathbreaker, so Gamechanger should be read as retired, not as a fifth mode
entries.source: RPGamer, GamingBolt, GameReactor, The Click, Wikipedia

entries.title: Official weapon totals published: 30+ Blades and 25 Phantom Edges
entries.summary: The founder and CEO of S-Game wrote a PlayStation Blog deep dive that put numbers on the arsenal for the first time, alongside confirmation of Donnie Yen's dual role.
facts: More than 30 main weapons, plus 25 secondary weapons called Phantom Edges
Weapons are upgraded and paired with accessories to form a build
Reforging a weapon returns its materials so they can be reinvested elsewhere
Defeating some enemies expands the arsenal; summons can assist in battle
Side quests can open new story paths, per the same post
Donnie Yen is kung fu creative consultant and also performs Mó Yuan through facial and motion capture
The setting is named the Wulin, and the studio's own genre term is kungfupunk
entries.source: PlayStation.Blog, signed by Soulframe Liang (S-Game founder and CEO)

entries.title: A demo page leaked on the Chinese PlayStation Store, then went unmentioned
entries.summary: A playable demo listing appeared on the Chinese PlayStation Store on 11 August. The dedicated State of Play a week later did not announce a demo, and no official confirmation has followed. Treat the demo as not announced.
facts: The leaked page is the only evidence a demo was planned
No demo was announced at the State of Play or in the October preview round
Absence is not cancellation, so the honest status is unannounced rather than cancelled

entries.title: Moved from September 9 to October 29, 2026
entries.summary: S-Game announced the delay in an open letter from the creator, alongside the start of pre-orders and a promise of a new trailer and a dedicated State of Play. Both promised items shipped in August.
facts: Release date is October 29, 2026, with October 28 in the US and select regions
Platforms are PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store; no Xbox version has been announced
The stated reason was quality: character models upgraded and many environments reworked
The studio said it aimed to hold the visual standard without depending on ray tracing, with ray tracing as an enhancement
